system.notes: Second test cut for the A/B path, built for both Pi 4 and Pi 5. Carries app 2026.08.0-beta.9.

proxy.notes: The hub can take proxy firmware from the release feed instead of only from its own image, so a board no longer has to wait for a hub release to move. It verifies the SHA-256 in the signed manifest before anything is offered, caches one version at a time, and never downgrades a board. The firmware built into the hub stays as the floor: a house with no internet still updates its own boards.
